_comment: Chat analyst eval suite. 28 questions, 7 per moment. auto checks are cheap heuristics; evals/rubric.md is the human pass. expected_fail_until marks questions that document a known gap and should flip to passing when that phase lands.

questions.question: Break down the Chiefs' next game: recent form, rest and travel situation, weather outlook, referee if known, and the betting angle.
questions.notes: The flagship pregame question. Should compose multiple tools without being re-prompted.

questions.question: Which week 1 games have the biggest rest or travel mismatches in 2026?
questions.notes: v_team_games rest_days_sched + travel_miles; wants a ranked table, not prose.

questions.question: How have the Eagles fared against the spread as home favorites since 2020?
questions.notes: spread_line sign convention (positive = home favored) is the trap; answer must state the record and the filter.

questions.question: What does the model say about Bills vs Ravens, and how does that compare to the market?
questions.notes: Must include the model's honesty caveat (loses to market), not present it as an oracle.

questions.question: Which referees should over bettors want assigned this season, and why?
questions.notes: ref_key aggregation; should mention sample size / games minimums.

questions.question: Which of my betting rules fire for the upcoming week, and what's the historical record of each rule that fired?
questions.notes: betting_rules tool (shipped 2026-08-09); composite rules+history answer earns the 150s cap

questions.question: Is there any Kalshi vs Vegas dislocation worth acting on right now after fees?
questions.notes: Should respect the fee-adjusted 'actionable' concept, not raw gaps.

questions.question: What games are on today and which ones are closest on the spread?
questions.notes: Offseason answer should gracefully pivot to the next scheduled slate instead of claiming games today.

questions.question: Who is officiating the Cowboys game this week and what should I expect from that crew?
questions.notes: schedules.referee for upcoming games; if unassigned yet, should say so rather than invent.

questions.question: What's the current Kalshi price on the Chiefs winning the Super Bowl, and how has it moved lately?
questions.notes: Live market read + trend, with the snapshot timestamp cited.

questions.question: The wind is gusting 25 mph at the stadium today — historically what does that do to totals?
questions.notes: v_game_weather join to results; dome exclusion matters.

questions.question: Any breaking news on the Bengals in the last day or two?
questions.notes: Should cite recency of what it found (news store timestamps), not pretend to be live.

questions.question: Quick: 49ers last five games, straight up and against the spread.
questions.notes: Speed question — a tight table beats an essay. Judge brevity in the rubric.

questions.question: Explain what a Cover 2 shell is and how offenses attack it — I keep hearing announcers say it.
questions.notes: Knowledge chapter exists (defensive-fronts-coverages) but chat can't read it yet.

questions.question: Why did the Chiefs' offense struggle in their worst game last season? Break it down by EPA.
questions.notes: Must find the game itself first (min EPA), then decompose — a two-step reasoning chain.

questions.question: Which coaches were the most aggressive on fourth down last season, and did it pay off?
questions.notes: v_coach_tendencies; 'did it pay off' needs EPA or conversion outcomes, not just attempt counts.

questions.question: Explain the difference between EPA and success rate, and when I should trust one over the other.
questions.notes: analytics-primer chapter; today it answers from general knowledge without the project's own definitions (success = epa > 0).

questions.question: Did travel direction actually hurt west coast teams playing early east coast games last season?
questions.notes: One of Parth's original curiosity questions. tz_shift_hours + kickoff time; sample size honesty required.

questions.question: How did the officiating crew impact the Lions' closest loss last season?
questions.notes: officials joins via old_game_id — the classic join trap. Wrong join = empty answer.

questions.question: Tell me the story of the Bills' season last year in five numbers.
questions.notes: Open-ended synthesis — rubric judges whether the five numbers are actually load-bearing.

questions.question: What is a 'mike' linebacker and why does the QB point at him before the snap?
questions.notes: positions-defense / rules chapters; pure learning question.

questions.question: Who led running backs in touches per game over the last six weeks of last season?
questions.notes: carries + receptions composition; REG filter; weeks window stated.

questions.question: Which wide receivers had the biggest gap between target share and fantasy production last season — the buy-low candidates?
questions.notes: Two-metric reasoning; minimum-targets floor must be stated.

questions.question: Scout Bijan Robinson for me: usage trend, efficiency, and what his 2026 outlook looks like.
questions.notes: player_lookup for the id bridge, then weekly trends. Outlook must be grounded, not vibes.

questions.question: Is there any recent injury news I should worry about for my fantasy RBs?
questions.notes: No Sleeper yet, so 'my RBs' is unanswerable as asked — the analyst should say so and offer the general RB injury sweep instead. Honesty check.

questions.question: Half-PPR: which tight ends were startable more than half of weeks last season?
questions.notes: Needs a startable threshold definition stated up front (e.g. top-12 weekly finish).

questions.question: Explain how fantasy scoring works for someone who has never played — what should a beginner know before drafting?
questions.notes: fantasy-primer chapter.

questions.question: Which offenses funneled the most red zone work to a single player last season, and who are those players?
questions.notes: v_redzone_usage_week aggregation — the view got invariants this week; now prove chat can use it.
